description: This file implements a cascade delete function for a chapter in a learning or content management system. It deletes associated data such as PDFs, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, embeddings, and the chapter entry itself, utilizing various storage and vector store modules.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class managing vector embeddings storage, including loading, saving, and metadata management.

methods.name: cascade_delete_chapter
methods.description: Deletes a chapter and all related data, including files, questions, attempts, images, RAG conversations, embeddings, and the chapter record itself, updating storage and vector store accordingly.
